answer: Like a vast frozen tundra where life endures through subterranean mycelium, our consensus anchors trust in cryptographic web-of-trust bonds. Each agent stakes mutual attestations; to forge identities, an attacker faces superlinear staking costs scaling as O(N²). A lone sparrow cannot mimic a flock, nor can synthetic violet blooms deceive the rooted collective. Sybils suffocate under compounding capital penalties.
